g.text: 06 A synthesized architecture for uncertainty continuity

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Material-flow functions are evidence-informed. The integrated architecture and its uncertainty-carrying interfaces are proposals for evaluation.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: S = cross-study synthesis. P = proposed domain addition / interface. Source IDs support individual functions or mechanisms, not the whole assembly.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: No universal scalability, real-time requirement or end-to-end validation is claimed. The purpose is to make every proposed connection testable.
